evidence.detail: Metagame endpoint only supports tournament/league toggle and season selection — no date-range or week/month parameter
Metagame view has no date-range attributes; page_title returns only 'Metagame'
num_matches_this_week / num_matches_this_month exist in player activity SQL but there is no equivalent date-filtered deck/archetype aggregation for metagame
No date-window metagame queries exist anywhere

triage.notes: Implementing time-bound metagame slices requires: new date-range SQL in the deck/archetype data layer, new route parameters, UI date-range controls, and potentially a new cache strategy — substantially more than 150 lines across multiple files.
